items.summary: FileCleanupMixin._delete_files() uses suppress(Exception), silently swallowing file deletion errors with no logging

evidence: Line 184: `with suppress(Exception):` around `value.delete(save=False)` — any OS, storage backend, or network error during file deletion is silently ignored
No logger.warning() or logger.error() call before or inside the suppress block
detail.suggestion: Replace suppress(Exception) with a specific catch for (OSError, FileNotFoundError, SuspiciousFileOperation) and add logger.warning() so deletion failures are at least observable in logs

items.summary: LoggingMixin.log_action() and LogMixin.log_action() have no exception handling around the LogEntry.objects.create() / logentry.save() DB write

evidence: base.py LoggingMixin.log_action() lines 93-118: logentry.save() is called with no try/except
mixins.py LogMixin.log_action() LogEntry.objects.create() is called with no try/except
A DB constraint violation in audit logging would propagate as an uncaught IntegrityError to the business operation that triggered it
detail.suggestion: Wrap the DB write in try/except (IntegrityError, OperationalError) and log at ERROR level if the audit entry cannot be written; this prevents audit logging failures from aborting business transactions
